race.description: Tabtouch - Westspeed Platinum Series Heat 1 Hcp
race.comment: GOD'S GATE (3) won well two back before being caught late when back to 1200m last time out. Steve Parnham sticks with him as he returns to the scene of the crime. Handled the wet deck last start and if he can run to that level again, he'll be very hard to hold out. FLYING MARADONA (2) is unbeaten this time in, scoring in both runs at Northam and producing strong ratings. He's a nice gelding on the way up and he may have enough speed to roll across from out wide. Beat a smart one last time and he looks well placed to bring up the hat-trick. BOSUN (5) missed first-up before bolting in to break his maiden at Northam last time out as an odds-on pop. He's been kept fresh since, with the form out of both runs this campaign stacking right up. RIGHT TO SILENCE (10) flew home to miss narrowly last time out and can't be discounted. LEMMOR FILOU (7) is building a handy record and can feature in the finish once again up in trip.
